name: WPMN Design System
description: AI-friendly component library and CSS design token system for 16 WPManageNinja product brands. Fetch a component's prompt.md to rebuild it from spec, or fetch its source files to use the code directly. Load token CSS first.

tokens.loadOrder: primitives -> brand-primitives -> tokens -> typography (or just index.css)
tokens.usage: Components must only use semantic tokens (--color-*, --btn-*, --input-*, --radius-*, --font-*, --shadow-*), never --primitive-* directly.

brandSwitching: Set data-brand="<key>" on the root or any section element.
darkMode: Set data-theme="dark" on <html>. Light is default.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status badge. 2 shape variants x 5 semantic types, light + dark themes. Uppercase expanded type.
interactions: none, purely presentational
tokensUsed: component-scoped --badge-bg and --badge-color set per type, hardcoded by design (not brand-mapped)
components.brands: all (colors identical across brands by design)

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Breadcrumb navigation. 4 style variants (border/flat/transparent/text), light + dark, optional home icon, arrow separators.

items.note: icon:true renders home icon; omit href for the active/current item

interactions: item hover: color shift to brand accent, 120ms ease
active item: aria-current=page, pointer-events none
a11y: nav aria-label=Breadcrumb, ordered list
components.knownExceptions: hover/active accent colors #1a1aa9 (light) and #8080ec (dark) are hardcoded from Figma, not yet tokenized

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary action button. 3 types, 5 sizes, 5 interactive states, optional icons, loading spinner, full-width mode.
interactions: background-color/border-color/color transition 120ms ease
primary: inset glow box-shadow on all non-disabled states
focus-visible: 3px solid border in --btn-bg-focused
loading: 1em spinner, 0.55s linear infinite rotation, pointer-events none
rules: Always pair primary + secondary side by side on marketing pages, never just one, never stacked

components.name: Footer
components.description: Full site footer. Brand/address column + social icon row + 3 nav columns, bottom bar with logo, copyright and links. Responsive at 1024px and 768px.
interactions: nav link hover: secondary -> primary text color, 120ms ease
social button hover: opacity 0.6
bottom link hover: opacity 0.65

breakpoints.768px: padding 48px 24px, columns wrap, bottom bar stacks

components.name: Icons
components.description: Inline SVG icon components extracted from @hugeicons/react-pro v0.3.2. No runtime imports, no bundler dependency. Reference file for icon path data used across components.
interactions: none
tokensUsed: none, icons inherit color via currentColor
components.iconStyle: HugeIcons Pro, stroke.rounded variant (solid.rounded used inside Breadcrumbs/Footer/SocialIcons)

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input with label, hint, error/success messaging, left/right icons. Stroke and fill variants, 3 sizes.

iconRight.note: auto alert-circle 24px on error, check-circle 20px on success

interactions: border-color/background-color/color transition 120ms ease
placeholder color shifts on hover, value color on focus
error replaces right icon with 24px alert-circle, success with 20px check-circle
a11y: aria-invalid, aria-describedby wired to message, role=alert on error

components.name: Logo
components.description: Inline SVG brand logo renderer. 16 brands x 2 variants (logo/icon) x 5 color types, all embedded in logos.js, no static file hosting needed.

variant.note: logo = icon mark + wordmark, icon = mark only

interactions: none
tokensUsed: none, SVG colors are baked in per type

typeUsage.white: monochrome white, dark backgrounds / reversed print

components.name: NavBar
components.description: Responsive site header. Desktop: logo + nav links + primary CTA. Mobile: logo + secondary CTA + hamburger with slide-down drawer.
interactions: link hover: color shift + light bg, 120ms ease
CTA hover/active/focus follow button primary states
hamburger toggles drawer, icon swaps hamburger/close
drawer link click closes drawer
a11y: aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-current on active link

components.name: SocialIcons
components.description: Standalone social icon button group. 7 platforms, sizable, light + dark.

size.note: button box px; icon renders at 60% of box

interactions: hover: opacity 0.65 + translateY(-1px), 120ms ease

components.name: Text
components.description: Polymorphic typography component. One component for every type style: 6 headings + 6 body variants, with color/weight/align/truncate controls.

as.note: overrides the smart default HTML tag

interactions: none

preview.jsx: Design once, ship 16 brandsEvery heading and paragraph maps to the WPMN type scale tokens.

per card N: grow scale base -> base*boost with a small lift over [S, S + N*110vh]; front card exits translateY(-736*u) + rotateX(15deg) over its own 100vh window (verbatim data-base/boost/lift/peek)

components.name: How It Works 3
components.description: Four full-viewport gradient step cards pin with position:sticky and squash away (scale to 0.70, rotateX to 27deg, per-card rotateZ tilt, late opacity fade) over a 942px pin while the next card slides over.
interactions: sticky-pin squash stack: each .scs-slide is 100vh + 942px tall (last 100vh), card is position:sticky top:0; per-card progress p = (scrollY - slideTop) / 942 clamped 0..1.35
card transform (verbatim from reference): scale = 1 - 0.3*p^2 (1 -> 0.70), rotateX = 27deg * p^1.6 (no perspective), rotateZ = per-card tilt * p^2 with tilts -3.5 / 0 / +4.3 / 0 deg (data-tilt)
card opacity: 1 until p ~0.85, fades linearly to 0 by p ~1.3 (continues past pin end); last card never shrinks

word flash-in: words hidden only once JS runs, revealed via opacity transition 0.12s linear with 70ms/word inline transition-delay when the block top crosses 75% of viewport height (checked from the update loop, no IntersectionObserver)
Get started button: per-letter roll-up on hover, two stacked char rows shift by one line-height (--font-lh-btn-md), transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.6,0,0.2,1) with 18ms/char transition-delay
dual drive: passive scroll listener + requestAnimationFrame loop (rAF dies in hidden docs, scroll covers embeds)
prefers-reduced-motion: transforms, flash hide, char roll and rAF loop all skipped; content rendered in final state
